title: GPT-5.5 matches heavily hyped Mythos Preview in new cybersecurity tests
brief: OpenAI's GPT-5.5 matched the cybersecurity performance of Anthropic's heavily promoted Mythos Preview in new benchmarks, suggesting Mythos' capabilities are not uniquely advanced. The results indicate that state-of-the-art models across companies are converging on similar threat-detection abilities rather than one model showing decisive superiority.
